ui_defect_resolutions.what: Two earlier recaptures on the Air failed: first only en-US came back; second gh-sim exited 0 yet capture.py reported every capture missing while ~/.gh-sim/results/sober-shots-mbair33dd-1105-115925-11969/shots held only en-US. Check that all --screen args reach gh-sim and that --id-file names the new result. Then recapture all target locales in one job, since raws are not in git and header fixes need every raw.
ui_defect_resolutions.resolution: Fixed: adapter now uses the fresh GH-SIM id-file, verifies exact screen mapping, retains partial captures, and captures all 70 target raw scenes across the successful 67 + 3 runs.
